t: The fight sours his mood for the rest of the day, poking at the back of his mind.
And he doesn’t hide it very well.

To be fair, he’s not exactly subtle.
Instead of inhaling his food, he’s simply picked at it for most of lunch.
“Peter, you’re barely eating,” Tim says.
“What gives?”
Peter pokes at his meal, eyes unfocused.
It isn’t until Steph nudges him with her elbow that he snaps out of it.
Oh, uh.
Just thinking, I guess.”
“You’re upset about gym class?”
Duke guesses.
Peter sighs, then nods.
“He actually made me lose my temper.
That hasn’t happened before.”
Sure, Flash is a massive jerk towards him, but it’s nothing close to the kind of…

So why is Edison bothering him so much now?
It’s the fact that he lost control of his temper, however brief.
He let his anger get to him, and that hasn’t happened before.

Leave Gotham to itself and use the suit to travel across the city at night.

“He was bound to hit a sore spot and piss you off eventually, Pete.

“Yeah, if that’s you ‘losing your temper’ then I don’t want to see you go into a berserk…

That’s the last thing he wants, too.
If he ever truly lost his temper, became furious beyond all control, he could level the…
He’s strong enough for that.
Powerful enough.
And that knowledge terrifies him on some level; you have to be careful and responsible…
Otherwise you’re just a monster.
“It wouldn’t be good,” Peter says, feeling oddly sick at the thought.
Acting selfishly with his powers had caused his Uncle Ben’s death.

“He won the match and lost against you in a fight, and that seems to be causing some…

He grabs a bread roll and takes a bite of it.
Class drags on.
He idly rubs his hand and drifts for most of it.

Even that’s enough to cause his hand discomfort.

Sure, he’s been stressed, and he’s not sleeping well, and he’s not eating well--

“You died.
I’m no doctor, but I’m pretty damn sure that even Cap himself would need a month or two…
That makes sense.
Peter isn’t sure what kind of healing factor Cap has.
He does know Tony compared their eating habits and informed him he eats nearly as much…
He's definitely not getting that kind food in Gotham.
Class ends with the teacher mentioning something about a school spirit day next week.
Peter isn’t paying attention.
Someone drops something on his desk as the final bell rings, startling him out of his…
He looks down at the desk and sees a bag of chips, then looks up and finds himself face…
“I figured you’d be starving by now.
You headed home?
I could use some company on the subway.”
I thought you, Tim, and Steph all rode together,” Peter says, shrugging on his backpack…
He tears open the packet and grabs a chip.

“Yeah, usually Steph drops me off at my job after school, but I’m going to visit my…

“Let’s go.”

“Come on, there’s a diner we can stop at, too.
I know you’re starving.”

Peter asks, walking with him out into the hall.

Batburger is, in fact, a very real place.

Tim drops a kid’s meal box in front of Peter just as he finishes off his third…

You get a free action figure.

Tim rolls his eyes at that, but only smirks in response, casting a glance through the…

Maybe Nightwing will serve the same purpose in Gotham.
His mood is a little lighter, at least.
But that could just as easily come from the food.
He ends up eating three meals’ worth of food: burgers, fries, two milkshakes, and a…
Duke and Tim seem content to chat with each other while he eats enough food to sustain…
They also pay for it without thinking; Peter feels a bit guilty about that, but he’s too…
He’ll pay them back after he gets his next check.
He’s polishing off the apple pie--not the best he’s ever had, and definitely not…
Tim and Duke go still, staring daggers at it, and it takes Peter a moment to figure out…
Edison Bright sits in his sports car, staring daggers into the restaurant.
Judging by the way his eyes roam across the front of it, he can’t actually see inside.
At least, not past the foggy mist that seems to just hover close to the ground of Gotham…
Duke stares daggers at Edison, and starts to get up.
Tim reaches up and grips his shoulder.
“Don’t,” Tim says.

“I’m happy to give him one,” Duke mutters, but sits back down.
His eyes never leave Edison.
“He’d just run from you,” Tim adds.
“Like he’s doing now.”
And Edison is moving.
He eases his shiny sports car back onto the street and then revs the engine a few times,…
And then it clicks for Peter.
Duke and Tim didn’t just happen to need the subway today.
Steph could have easily driven them over to the Narrows despite the traffic; they walked…
Peter boggles at that.
This is something Ned would do for him, without a second thought, and he wishes suddenly…
“Hey, Peter, why don’t you come home with us?”
Tim says, breaking Peter out of his thoughts.
“You can swing by the Narrows with us first and meet some friends of mine, and then stay…
Peter shakes his head.
He’d love to sleep in an actual bed, but he needs to finish his spider suit.
Without the suit, he can’t start working out how to get home: he needs the suit to be…
“Sorry, guys.
Not tonight.”
Tim seems disappointed by that.
“Next time, then.”
“Yeah, definitely,” Peter says, standing up and gathering his trash.
It’s pretty sizable; he really did a number on the menu here.
“Thanks for the meal, guys.
I’ll pay you back sometime, promise.
See you at school tomorrow!”
Tim and Duke wave after him.
Peter can’t help but notice the pinched, worried look they share when he turns his back…

Peter says.

Good enough for five minutes of effort, at least.
He caps the pen, puts it back on the table, and immediately digs into his lunch.
Maybe Spider-Man won’t come to Gotham, but he can still help in other ways.
Nightwing’s suit, for example.
Assuming he pays attention to this fan club of his and accepts suit designs, anyway.
Tony never did.
